name: qlrisk_price_cross_currency_swap
title: Price a CrossCurrencySwap
description:
Price one Cross-Currency Swap (qlrisk CrossCurrencySwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, frequency=semi-annual, pair=EURUSD, foreign_curve=ESTR, domestic_coupon_pct, foreign_coupon_pct, foreign_notional, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV -1,006.80 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
